faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover Velar D250 use?
faqLeft.a: The Velar D250 uses the Ingenium AJ300D — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel. It's been fitted across the entire L560 generation since the Velar's launch in 2017.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover Velar D250 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200 for the AJ300D. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Velar D250?
faqLeft.a: All Velar D250 models use the AJ300D 3.0-litre diesel. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ300D Velar D250 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, injector seals, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Velar D250 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Velar D250 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Velar D250 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Velar owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
